title: 早上六点四十五分  (Six Forty-Five)

segments.t: It is six forty-five in the morning at Courtyard Inn in Chengdu. While the guests still sleep upstairs, Chen sketches a quick street map on paper for Qing. Listen to the whole scene first.
老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
跟河水一样凉。把这个坏铜阀门装进外套口袋。
装好了。快告诉我五金店怎么走。
出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
店门外面有大招牌吗？
门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
Now let's walk through the directions, one line at a time.
跟河水一样凉。把这个坏铜阀门装进外套口袋。
'Cold as river water. Put this broken brass valve into your coat pocket.' Comparisons in Mandarin follow 'with river-water same cold', slotting what you compare right between 'with' and 'same'.
装好了。快告诉我五金店怎么走。
'Got it in. Now tell me quickly how to get to the hardware shop.' Essential street-direction question:
怎么走
literally 'how walk', asks 'how do I get there?' for any place.
出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
'Go out the front gate, turn left, and walk straight to the stone bridge.' Keep walking straight ahead with
一直走
where 'one-straight' tells your feet never to turn.
出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
'Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?' Crossing a street, bridge, or river uses
过
so 'pass-river' means cross to the other bank.
过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
'Cross the bridge, green pharmacy on the right. And after that?' Linking stories and directions uses
然后
meaning 'after that' or 'next'.
再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
'Then turn left into the small square and look for a blue wooden door.' Doors and windows that swing or slide in a frame take
扇
originally a woven bamboo door leaf.
二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
'Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!' Standard metric sizes use
毫米
literally 'fine-hair metre', Mandarin's neat compound for millimetre.
快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
'Run fast, Qing. Room four wakes up at a quarter past seven!' Clock quarters use
一刻
meaning fifteen minutes—so 'seven o'clock one quarter' is seven fifteen. Now let's listen to the whole conversation again from start to finish.
老陈早！楼上洗澡水真的已经凉了吗？
跟河水一样凉。把这个坏铜阀门装进外套口袋。
装好了。快告诉我五金店怎么走。
出大门往左拐，一直走到石桥。
出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
对，过了桥，右手边会经过一家绿药店。
过桥，右边经过绿药店。然后呢？
再往左拐进小广场，找一扇蓝木门。
店门外面有大招牌吗？
门上方只画着一把金色钥匙。拿旧阀门给店员看。
二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
快跑吧，小晴。四号房七点一刻就醒！
Left outside the gate, straight to the stone bridge, past the green pharmacy, and left into the square—Qing is off on her dawn run. See you next time.
回头见！
